subject.title: fix(media): apply SSRF guard to byteplus and runway generated video downloads

question: Should `fetchGuardedProviderDownloadResponse` be accepted as the public plugin-SDK seam for default-deny generated-media downloads across bundled and external provider plugins?
rationale: The patch correctly follows the repository's plugin-boundary rule, but exporting a new provider HTTP helper establishes a durable external API and intentionally changes the default result-download security boundary.

options.title: Approve the generic guarded helper
options.body: Accept the public SDK helper as the canonical seam, provided the explicit private-network opt-in remains supported end to end.

options.title: Require provider-entrypoint opt-in proof first
options.body: Ask for a controlled BytePlus or Runway provider-flow test that proves an intentionally private result URL succeeds only when the existing opt-in is configured.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic guarded helper
recommendation.body: Accept the public SDK helper as the canonical seam, provided the explicit private-network opt-in remains supported end to end.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged related provider-policy work is the closest current-main precedent for the intended shared guarded-download boundary.
